comments.body:
Hello,
I contact you about Wordpress plugin. When I enable "Disable OneSignal initialization" in Advanced settings, it seems like it still initializes.
Furthermore, when I add the script manually to my "functions.php" child. I get the following error when I check Chrome's Dev console :
- windows.OneSignal already defined as 'object' (https://i.imgur.com/JHsl1cg.png)

I guess it's because OneSignal is initialized twice because the wordpress plugin doesn't disable the initialization. Any idea ?
